name: Prafull Sharma
shortBio: Managing Director with a strong technology background and 6 years of experience in software development, focused on driving efficient hospital operations, digital transformation and cost-effective technology solutions.
description: Prafull Sharma is the Managing Director of the organization, responsible for strategic direction, business development, technology initiatives and the overall growth of the hospital.

With a strong background in software development and 5.8 years of professional experience, he brings a technology-driven approach to healthcare management, focusing on improving operational efficiency and creating better digital experiences for patients and staff.

His expertise includes developing customized CRM and ERP solutions, business automation, AI integration and end-to-end software solutions designed to address specific organizational requirements while keeping implementation practical and cost-effective.

As Managing Director, he focuses on combining healthcare operations with modern technology, supporting efficient processes, digital transformation, service improvement and the long-term growth of the organization.

name: Dr. Naman Singhal
shortBio: A dedicated Ayurvedic physician committed to personalized care and sustainable wellness.
description: Dr. Naman Singhal is a dedicated Ayurvedic physician providing personalized and holistic healthcare.
His approach combines traditional Ayurvedic principles with a patient-centered approach to support long-term health and well-being.
He focuses on helping patients understand their health needs and adopt sustainable Ayurvedic lifestyle practices for better overall wellness.
He provides authentic Ayurvedic treatments integrated with a modern scientific approach for effective and satisfactory outcomes.

name: Dr Shivam Pant
shortBio: An Ayurvedic physician specializing in personalized treatment, disease-specific Ayurvedic medicine formulation, and individualized therapeutic care.
description: Dr. Shivam Pant is an Ayurvedic physician with a focused approach to personalized and disease-specific Ayurvedic healthcare.

He specializes in developing individualized treatment protocols and selecting or formulating Ayurvedic medicines based on the patient's clinical condition, presenting symptoms, individual requirements, and Ayurvedic assessment.

His clinical approach integrates classical Ayurvedic principles with systematic patient assessment, appropriate therapeutic planning, personalized medicine selection, and guidance on diet and lifestyle to support comprehensive patient care.
